summary: An independent audit found no mathematical errors or gaps. Small-dimensional, translated and lower-dimensional buffer sets, half-open cell endpoints, constant halfspace functionals after lifting, empty or zero-volume erosions, and the limiting specialization cases do not refute the statement. The two displayed Borel shears preserve volume and have the claimed inclusions, including the opposite phase in the erosion comparison. For every admissible E, nearest-integer rounding leaves the required inner projection cube, and corner interpolation fixes w, D, and its mixed-integer centroid before the halfspace is chosen. Accepted fact 92e80d28d7127cde applies with r equal to alpha inverse and f equal to the linear functional composed with the multi-affine lift. Its unit-volume basins make the fiber-translation inequality integrate to the simultaneous halfspace comparison; cross-fiber injectivity is not needed. The centroid-specific constant and hypotheses were checked in Section 3, page 1259, of [Grunbaum's original paper](https://msp.org/pjm/1960/10-4/pjm-v10-n4-p18-p.pdf). The depth inequalities, positivity of the denominator, erosion choice, and convexity-based specialization for P contained in C all follow with the stated quantifiers and boundary conditions.
